verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at help.angelliststack.com that indexes the help center as markdown links. The help pages themselves are served as .md files, as the cited docs URLs show, so an agent can be pointed at clean, agent-readable documentation. Missing for 10: any first-party documentation announcing or describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, evidence of an llms-full.txt or coverage beyond the Stack help center (e.g., angellist.com fund and investor products), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
